en.headline: Customs seize 240 kg of cannabis worth HK$56 m, arrest 10 in airport operation
en.dek: Month-long ‘Fire Mesh’ action targeted a syndicate using Hong Kong as a transit hub to move cannabis buds from Southeast Asia to Europe and Africa.
body: Hong Kong Customs announced on Tuesday that a month-long operation code-named Fire Mesh had resulted in the seizure of about 240 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of HK$56 million and the arrest of 10 people.

The operation, which ran from 13 July to 17 August, focused on transit baggage arriving from Southeast Asia. Officers said X-ray scans of the suitcases showed tightly packed uniform parcels and no personal items of the kind expected on long-haul journeys; the bags themselves also appeared new and little-used.

Nine men and one woman aged between 18 and 57, of various nationalities, were arrested at the airport. Customs said the syndicate had recruited travellers with financial incentives to carry the drugs via Hong Kong in an attempt to evade scrutiny in destination countries.

zh.headline: 海關「火網」行動檢240公斤大麻市值5600萬 拘10人
zh.dek: 為期一個月行動針對以香港為中轉站、由東南亞運大麻往歐洲及非洲的集團，於機場過境行李發現可疑包裹。
body: 香港海關周二公布，代號「火網」的反跨國販毒行動檢獲約240公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值5600萬元，並拘捕10人。
行動由7月13日至8月17日進行，重點檢查由東南亞抵港的過境行李。人員表示，涉案行李箱的X光影像顯示內裡裝滿高密度單一類別包裹，並無一般長途旅客應有的個人物品，行李箱本身亦幾乎沒有使用痕跡。
被捕者包括9男1女，年齡介乎18至57歲，屬不同國籍。海關指集團以金錢利益招攬旅客經香港偷運毒品，企圖避開目的地執法檢查。
